record.label: Accuracy-first fitted innovation route
record.summary: Teacher-forced residual innovation crosses the 1e-8 raw-MSE boundary, but the best verified autonomous full-population providers remain near 3.23e-8. Rank-16 cross-unit covariance improves J by only 0.1044%, and its truth-coefficient factor-span oracle remains at 2.8928320722187982e-8. The open question is now a materially full-rank nonlinear residual-state operator, not whether a local correction signal exists.
record.terminal_criterion: Produce a frozen Phase-2-legal autonomous fitted correction that is finite and improves protected final-layer raw MSE; retain <1e-8 as the governing success threshold.
